m702-seasons.observed_description: Four framed photographs in a row on a white wall, each the same big tree on a hill: in blossom (spring), in full green leaf under blue sky (summer), with orange leaves (fall) and bare in snow (winter).
m702-seasons.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo.

m703-landscape.observed_description: A wide grassy landscape: a snow-capped mountain on the left horizon, a still lake reflecting it, a narrow winding river running through the meadow, and one big green tree on the right.
m703-landscape.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The river also curves below the lake; its target covers its clear middle stretch.
